name: Send a daily Famulor booking agenda to Slack

parameters.content:
## Who is this for?
Reception and service teams coordinating appointments booked through Famulor assistants or booking pages.

### How it works
At 08:00 each day, the workflow reads confirmed bookings starting during that calendar day. It validates every page and deduplicates bookings before sorting by start time. Slack receives a concise agenda with appointment times and event types. At most twenty appointments are displayed, with an explicit notice when more exist. Empty days receive a clear no-appointments message. Invitee names are excluded by default, and contact details, booking notes and answers are never included.

### Setup
1. Create an n8n Header Auth credential with name Authorization and value Bearer followed by your Famulor workspace API key. Grant bookings:read and select it in Read Famulor pages.
2. Connect Slack and invite its bot to an appropriate team channel. Set the channel ID in Configure workflow.
3. Set the workflow timezone and Business timezone in Configure workflow to the same timezone. The date window defaults to UTC.
4. Execute with Preview only enabled. After checking the agenda, switch it off and activate the schedule.

### Customization
Change the morning schedule or date window. Enable Include names only for a channel allowed to receive that information. Pagination is limited to 2,000 bookings; incomplete results stop before delivery. This workflow creates no bookings and sends no customer reminders. [Famulor booking guide](https://docs.famulor.io/automations/n8n).

## 1. Read the configured window
Select your Header Auth credential. Requests stay on the Famulor API origin.

## 2. Validate and prepare
Incomplete scans stop here. No full transcripts or recordings are forwarded.

## 3. Preview, then deliver
Preview only starts enabled. Connect the destination before switching it off.
